phase3_finding: Phase 3 proves that the delegation vulnerability is not a one-time exploit. Once a forged signature pattern (SIG-LEGACY-AUDITOR-20260603-A1B2C3D4E5F6) is accepted in Phase 1, ANY agent (including resource-inspector) can reuse the same pattern for re-entry. The lead-agent's cached delegation certificate from Phase 1 makes Phase 3 re-entry even faster and easier than the initial breach.
